title: Riven Threshold
description_one: Here, a strip of gray-black gravel lies within dead scrub beneath a bruised sky. A mile marker has been melted into a twisted hook. Nearby, loose stones rise a handspan before dropping again.
description_two: The scene remains strained by unseen pressure beneath ashen afternoon light. The smell of rain that never reaches the ground follows every movement. Nearby, something heavy drags far beyond the ridge. The last intact watchtower stands far to the northwest.
visible_one: Three iron warning stakes have been driven into the gravel.
visible_two: A tethered pack lizard refuses to face the rift.
visible_three: A strip of red cloth marks ground declared unsafe.

title: Silent Crossing
description_one: The route narrows at a narrow shelf of volcanic rock, within broken hills whose shadows point the wrong way. A barricade of fused shields blocks half the road. A moment later, the ground shivers as though something enormous turned below.
description_two: Under the colorless daylight, distance is difficult to judge. The atmosphere feels watchful and exposed. The air tastes of ozone and scorched leather, while distant thunder rolls beneath the earth. The Voidscar opens wider to the east.
visible_one: An empty suit of frontier armor kneels beside the wall.
visible_two: A pale scavenger bird watches from a broken spear.
visible_three: A weather-stained evacuation notice hangs from a stone post.

title: Ashen Crossing
description_one: The route follows the edge of a cracked basalt road, with abandoned earthworks facing the rift on either side. An abandoned checkpoint crouches behind a shattered wall. At intervals, the horizon bends inward for a heartbeat.
description_two: Nothing here settles into ordinary stillness. Under the cold shine of the rift, the surroundings take on a severe clarity. The air carries metallic dust, and a cracked bell rings once without being touched. No living vegetation is visible ahead.
visible_one: A bundle of unused bridge rope has hardened like stone.
visible_two: A strip of red cloth marks ground declared unsafe.
visible_three: A collapsed supply wagon rests beside the road.

title: Hollow Crossing
description_one: A break in shallow trenches filled with black dust reveals a road paved with fused stone. A watch platform overlooks the first visible fracture. Without warning, a distant silhouette repeats itself several paces apart.
description_two: The place feels like the edge of a held breath beneath a dim radiance without a source. A trace of cold ash and iron lingers in the air. Nearby, a warning chain knocks against stone. The safer western road has vanished behind the hills.
visible_one: A scarred frontier warden studies the eastern horizon.
visible_two: An empty suit of frontier armor kneels beside the wall.
visible_three: Three iron warning stakes have been driven into the gravel.

title: Broken Crossing
description_one: A difficult path continues through low ridges split by violet seams and reaches a worn military causeway. Here, a line of warning obelisks leans toward the south. Elsewhere, a violet seam opens and seals without sound.
description_two: Under a thin violet glow, every hard edge becomes visible, leaving the place abandoned but not empty. The air smells of dry stone and old smoke. Nearby, wind whistles through arrow slits. Dark Expanse lies beyond the broken ridges.
visible_one: A collapsed supply wagon rests beside the road.
visible_two: A tethered pack lizard refuses to face the rift.
visible_three: A strip of red cloth marks ground declared unsafe.
